@@ -0,0 +1,131 @@
+package tracing
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"net"
+	"net/url"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"sync"
+
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/jaeger"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracegrpc"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracehttp"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/zipkin"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/resource"
+	tracesdk "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/trace"
+	semconv "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/semconv/v1.4.0"
+)
+
+func newResource(ctx context.Context, fliptVersion string) (*resource.Resource, error) {
+	return resource.New(ctx,
+		resource.WithSchemaURL(semconv.SchemaURL),
+		resource.WithAttributes(
+			semconv.ServiceNameKey.String("flipt"),
+			semconv.ServiceVersionKey.String(fliptVersion),
+		),
+		resource.WithFromEnv(),
+	)
+}
+
+// NewProvider creates a tracer provider with Flipt's resource and always-on sampling.
+func NewProvider(ctx context.Context, fliptVersion string) (*tracesdk.TracerProvider, error) {
+	r, err := newResource(ctx, fliptVersion)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	return tracesdk.NewTracerProvider(
+		tracesdk.WithResource(r),
+		tracesdk.WithSampler(tracesdk.AlwaysSample()),
+	), nil
+}
+
+// GetExporter creates an exporter for cfg and returns its shutdown function.
+// Each call owns its exporter, so separate server instances can use separate configurations.
+func GetExporter(ctx context.Context, cfg *config.TracingConfig) (tracesdk.SpanExporter, func(context.Context) error, error) {
+	if cfg == nil {
+		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("tracing config is nil")
+	}
+
+	var (
+		exporter tracesdk.SpanExporter
+		err      error
+	)
+	switch cfg.Exporter {
+	case config.TracingJaeger:
+		exporter, err = jaeger.New(jaeger.WithAgentEndpoint(
+			jaeger.WithAgentHost(cfg.Jaeger.Host),
+			jaeger.WithAgentPort(strconv.Itoa(cfg.Jaeger.Port)),
+		))
+	case config.TracingZipkin:
+		exporter, err = zipkin.New(cfg.Zipkin.Endpoint)
+	case config.TracingOTLP:
+		var client otlptrace.Client
+		client, err = otlpClient(cfg.OTLP)
+		if err == nil {
+			exporter, err = otlptrace.New(ctx, client)
+		}
+	default:
+		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported tracing exporter: %s", cfg.Exporter)
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, nil, err
+	}
+
+	var once sync.Once
+	var shutdownErr error
+	shutdown := func(ctx context.Context) error {
+		once.Do(func() { shutdownErr = exporter.Shutdown(ctx) })
+		return shutdownErr
+	}
+	return exporter, shutdown, nil
+}
+
+func otlpClient(cfg config.OTLPTracingConfig) (otlptrace.Client, error) {
+	endpoint := cfg.Endpoint
+	hasScheme := strings.Contains(endpoint, "://")
+	if !hasScheme {
+		endpoint = "grpc://" + endpoint
+	}
+	u, err := url.Parse(endpoint)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: %w", err)
+	}
+	if u.Hostname() == "" || u.User != nil || u.RawQuery != "" || u.Fragment != "" {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: invalid endpoint %q", cfg.Endpoint)
+	}
+	if !hasScheme {
+		if _, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(u.Host); err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: %w", err)
+		}
+	}
+
+	switch u.Scheme {
+	case "http", "https":
+		opts := []otlptracehttp.Option{
+			otlptracehttp.WithEndpoint(u.Host),
+			otlptracehttp.WithHeaders(cfg.Headers),
+		}
+		if u.Path != "" {
+			opts = append(opts, otlptracehttp.WithURLPath(u.Path))
+		}
+		if u.Scheme == "http" {
+			opts = append(opts, otlptracehttp.WithInsecure())
+		}
+		return otlptracehttp.NewClient(opts...), nil
+	case "grpc":
+		if u.Path != "" {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: unexpected path %q", u.Path)
+		}
+		return otlptracegrpc.NewClient(
+			otlptracegrpc.WithEndpoint(u.Host),
+			otlptracegrpc.WithHeaders(cfg.Headers),
+			otlptracegrpc.WithInsecure(),
+		), nil
+	default:
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: unsupported scheme %q", u.Scheme)
+	}
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,96 @@
+package tracing
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/attribute"
+)
+
+func TestNewResource(t *testing.T) {
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_SERVICE_NAME", "")
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES", "")
+	r, err := newResource(ctx, "1.2.3")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	checkAttribute(t, r.Set(), "service.name", "flipt")
+	checkAttribute(t, r.Set(), "service.version", "1.2.3")
+
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_SERVICE_NAME", "from-env")
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES", "deployment.environment=test,service.version=from-env")
+	r, err = newResource(ctx, "1.2.3")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	checkAttribute(t, r.Set(), "service.name", "from-env")
+	checkAttribute(t, r.Set(), "service.version", "from-env")
+	checkAttribute(t, r.Set(), "deployment.environment", "test")
+}
+
+func checkAttribute(t *testing.T, attrs *attribute.Set, key attribute.Key, want string) {
+	t.Helper()
+	got, ok := attrs.Value(key)
+	if !ok || got.AsString() != want {
+		t.Fatalf("attribute %s = %q (found %v), want %q", key, got.AsString(), ok, want)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestNewProvider(t *testing.T) {
+	p, err := NewProvider(context.Background(), "1.2.3")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = p.Shutdown(context.Background()) })
+	_, span := p.Tracer("test").Start(context.Background(), "sampled")
+	defer span.End()
+	if !span.SpanContext().TraceFlags().IsSampled() {
+		t.Fatal("provider did not sample span")
+	}
+}
+
+func TestGetExporter(t *testing.T) {
+	cases := []struct {
+		name string
+		cfg  config.TracingConfig
+	}{
+		{"Jaeger", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingJaeger, Jaeger: config.JaegerTracingConfig{Host: "localhost", Port: 6831}}},
+		{"Zipkin", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingZipkin, Zipkin: config.ZipkinTracingConfig{Endpoint: "http://localhost:9411/api/v2/spans"}}},
+		{"OTLP HTTP", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "http://localhost:4317", Headers: map[string]string{"key": "value"}}}},
+		{"OTLP HTTPS", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "https://localhost:4317", Headers: map[string]string{"key": "value"}}}},
+		{"OTLP GRPC", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "grpc://localhost:4317", Headers: map[string]string{"key": "value"}}}},
+		{"OTLP host:port", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "localhost:4317", Headers: map[string]string{"key": "value"}}}},
+	}
+	for _, tc := range cases {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			exporter, shutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), &tc.cfg)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			if exporter == nil || shutdown == nil {
+				t.Fatal("missing exporter or shutdown")
+			}
+			if err := shutdown(context.Background()); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			if err := shutdown(context.Background()); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+
+	for _, endpoint := range []string{"http://", "http://localhost:bad", "ftp://localhost:4317", "localhost"} {
+		cfg := config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: endpoint}}
+		_, _, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), &cfg)
+		if err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "parsing otlp endpoint:") {
+			t.Errorf("endpoint %q: expected parsing error, got %v", endpoint, err)
+		}
+	}
+	_, _, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), &config.TracingConfig{})
+	if err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "unsupported tracing exporter:") {
+		t.Fatalf("expected unsupported exporter error, got %v", err)
+	}
+}

+package tracing
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"net"
+	"net/url"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"sync"
+
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/jaeger"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracegrpc"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracehttp"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/zipkin"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/resource"
+	tracesdk "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/trace"
+	semconv "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/semconv/v1.4.0"
+)
+
+func newResource(ctx context.Context, fliptVersion string) (*resource.Resource, error) {
+	return resource.New(ctx,
+		resource.WithSchemaURL(semconv.SchemaURL),
+		resource.WithAttributes(
+			semconv.ServiceNameKey.String("flipt"),
+			semconv.ServiceVersionKey.String(fliptVersion),
+		),
+		resource.WithFromEnv(),
+	)
+}
+
+// NewProvider creates a tracer provider with Flipt's resource and always-on sampling.
+func NewProvider(ctx context.Context, fliptVersion string) (*tracesdk.TracerProvider, error) {
+	r, err := newResource(ctx, fliptVersion)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	return tracesdk.NewTracerProvider(
+		tracesdk.WithResource(r),
+		tracesdk.WithSampler(tracesdk.AlwaysSample()),
+	), nil
+}
+
+// GetExporter creates an exporter for cfg and returns its shutdown function.
+// Each call owns its exporter, so separate server instances can use separate configurations.
+func GetExporter(ctx context.Context, cfg *config.TracingConfig) (tracesdk.SpanExporter, func(context.Context) error, error) {
+	if cfg == nil {
+		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("tracing config is nil")
+	}
+
+	var (
+		exporter tracesdk.SpanExporter
+		err      error
+	)
+	switch cfg.Exporter {
+	case config.TracingJaeger:
+		exporter, err = jaeger.New(jaeger.WithAgentEndpoint(
+			jaeger.WithAgentHost(cfg.Jaeger.Host),
+			jaeger.WithAgentPort(strconv.Itoa(cfg.Jaeger.Port)),
+		))
+	case config.TracingZipkin:
+		exporter, err = zipkin.New(cfg.Zipkin.Endpoint)
+	case config.TracingOTLP:
+		var client otlptrace.Client
+		client, err = otlpClient(cfg.OTLP)
+		if err == nil {
+			exporter, err = otlptrace.New(ctx, client)
+		}
+	default:
+		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported tracing exporter: %s", cfg.Exporter)
+	}
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, nil, err
+	}
+
+	var once sync.Once
+	var shutdownErr error
+	shutdown := func(ctx context.Context) error {
+		once.Do(func() { shutdownErr = exporter.Shutdown(ctx) })
+		return shutdownErr
+	}
+	return exporter, shutdown, nil
+}
+
+func otlpClient(cfg config.OTLPTracingConfig) (otlptrace.Client, error) {
+	endpoint := cfg.Endpoint
+	hasScheme := strings.Contains(endpoint, "://")
+	if !hasScheme {
+		endpoint = "grpc://" + endpoint
+	}
+	u, err := url.Parse(endpoint)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: %w", err)
+	}
+	if u.Hostname() == "" || u.User != nil || u.RawQuery != "" || u.Fragment != "" {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: invalid endpoint %q", cfg.Endpoint)
+	}
+	if !hasScheme {
+		if _, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(u.Host); err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: %w", err)
+		}
+	}
+
+	switch u.Scheme {
+	case "http", "https":
+		opts := []otlptracehttp.Option{
+			otlptracehttp.WithEndpoint(u.Host),
+			otlptracehttp.WithHeaders(cfg.Headers),
+		}
+		if u.Path != "" {
+			opts = append(opts, otlptracehttp.WithURLPath(u.Path))
+		}
+		if u.Scheme == "http" {
+			opts = append(opts, otlptracehttp.WithInsecure())
+		}
+		return otlptracehttp.NewClient(opts...), nil
+	case "grpc":
+		if u.Path != "" {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: unexpected path %q", u.Path)
+		}
+		return otlptracegrpc.NewClient(
+			otlptracegrpc.WithEndpoint(u.Host),
+			otlptracegrpc.WithHeaders(cfg.Headers),
+			otlptracegrpc.WithInsecure(),
+		), nil
+	default:
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing otlp endpoint: unsupported scheme %q", u.Scheme)
+	}
+}

+package tracing
+
+import (
+	"context"

+
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/attribute"
+)
+
+func TestNewResource(t *testing.T) {
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_SERVICE_NAME", "")
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES", "")
+	r, err := newResource(ctx, "1.2.3")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	checkAttribute(t, r.Set(), "service.name", "flipt")
+	checkAttribute(t, r.Set(), "service.version", "1.2.3")
+
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_SERVICE_NAME", "from-env")
+	t.Setenv("OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES", "deployment.environment=test,service.version=from-env")
+	r, err = newResource(ctx, "1.2.3")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	checkAttribute(t, r.Set(), "service.name", "from-env")
+	checkAttribute(t, r.Set(), "service.version", "from-env")
+	checkAttribute(t, r.Set(), "deployment.environment", "test")
+}
+
+func checkAttribute(t *testing.T, attrs *attribute.Set, key attribute.Key, want string) {
+	t.Helper()
+	got, ok := attrs.Value(key)
+	if !ok || got.AsString() != want {
+		t.Fatalf("attribute %s = %q (found %v), want %q", key, got.AsString(), ok, want)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestNewProvider(t *testing.T) {
+	p, err := NewProvider(context.Background(), "1.2.3")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	t.Cleanup(func() { _ = p.Shutdown(context.Background()) })
+	_, span := p.Tracer("test").Start(context.Background(), "sampled")
+	defer span.End()
+	if !span.SpanContext().TraceFlags().IsSampled() {
+		t.Fatal("provider did not sample span")
+	}
+}
+
+func TestGetExporter(t *testing.T) {
+	cases := []struct {
+		name string
+		cfg  config.TracingConfig
+	}{
+		{"Jaeger", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingJaeger, Jaeger: config.JaegerTracingConfig{Host: "localhost", Port: 6831}}},
+		{"Zipkin", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingZipkin, Zipkin: config.ZipkinTracingConfig{Endpoint: "http://localhost:9411/api/v2/spans"}}},
+		{"OTLP HTTP", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "http://localhost:4317", Headers: map[string]string{"key": "value"}}}},
+		{"OTLP HTTPS", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "https://localhost:4317", Headers: map[string]string{"key": "value"}}}},
+		{"OTLP GRPC", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "grpc://localhost:4317", Headers: map[string]string{"key": "value"}}}},
+		{"OTLP host:port", config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: "localhost:4317", Headers: map[string]string{"key": "value"}}}},
+	}
+	for _, tc := range cases {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			exporter, shutdown, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), &tc.cfg)
+			if err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			if exporter == nil || shutdown == nil {
+				t.Fatal("missing exporter or shutdown")
+			}
+			if err := shutdown(context.Background()); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+			if err := shutdown(context.Background()); err != nil {
+				t.Fatal(err)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+
+	for _, endpoint := range []string{"http://", "http://localhost:bad", "ftp://localhost:4317", "localhost"} {
+		cfg := config.TracingConfig{Exporter: config.TracingOTLP, OTLP: config.OTLPTracingConfig{Endpoint: endpoint}}
+		_, _, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), &cfg)
+		if err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "parsing otlp endpoint:") {
+			t.Errorf("endpoint %q: expected parsing error, got %v", endpoint, err)
+		}
+	}
+	_, _, err := GetExporter(context.Background(), &config.TracingConfig{})
+	if err == nil || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "unsupported tracing exporter:") {
+		t.Fatalf("expected unsupported exporter error, got %v", err)
+	}
+}
